payload.goal: Register payment of invoice of 11219 EUR to Bølgekraft AS at exchange rate 10.29 NOK/EUR, and post the currency gain (agio) resulting from the difference between invoice rate (10.02) and payment rate (10.29) to the correct account.

Payment amount: 11219 EUR at 10.29 NOK/EUR = 115,443.51 NOK
Agio account: typically account 8060 (Agio) in Norwegian standard chart of accounts
Bank account in NOK or EUR
success_checks: Invoice of 11219 EUR is marked as fully paid
Payment is registered at exchange rate 10.29 NOK/EUR
Currency gain (agio) of 3,029.13 NOK is posted to account 8060 or equivalent agio account
Accounts receivable (1500) is cleared/zeroed for this invoice
Voucher reflects both the bank debit (115,443.51 NOK) and the original receivable (112,414.38 NOK) plus agio credit (3,029.13 NOK)
risk_notes: Sandbox is empty: customer Bølgekraft AS must be created before invoice can be registered
Bank account in correct currency (EUR or NOK) must be configured before payment registration
Tripletex must have multi-currency (valuta) module enabled to handle EUR invoices
Agio account number must be confirmed in the chart of accounts (typically 8060 in NS 4102)
Exchange rates must be manually entered if not auto-fetched from Norges Bank
If payment was received in EUR to a EUR bank account, the NOK equivalent depends on the bank's settlement rate — confirm 10.29 is the correct rate used

payload.suggested_first_action: Enable multi-currency module in Tripletex (Settings → Modules → Currency), then create customer Bølgekraft AS with org.nr 825006206.

line_items.description: Faktura til Bølgekraft AS — 11219 EUR (kurs 10.02 NOK/EUR ved fakturering)

ordered_steps: 1. Enable multi-currency module: PUT /module {name: 'currency', enabled: true}
2. Create customer Bølgekraft AS: POST /customer {name: 'Bølgekraft AS', organizationNumber: '825006206', currency: 'EUR'}
3. Ensure EUR bank account is configured: POST /bank/account or verify existing
4. Create invoice in EUR: POST /invoice {customerId: <id>, currency: 'EUR', invoiceDate: <date>, lines: [{amount: 11219 EUR}], currencyRate: 10.02}
5. Send/finalize invoice so it is outstanding (status: UNPAID)
6. Register payment: POST /invoice/{id}/payment {amount: 11219, currency: 'EUR', currencyRate: 10.29, paymentDate: <today>, bankAccountId: <id>}
7. Tripletex will auto-calculate agio: (10.29 - 10.02) * 11219 = 3,029.13 NOK — verify this is posted to account 8060 (Agio) as a credit
8. If agio is not auto-posted, create manual voucher: POST /ledger/voucher with debit 1500 (112,414.38 NOK), debit bank (115,443.51 NOK), credit 8060 (3,029.13 NOK)
9. Verify accounts receivable (1500) is fully cleared for this customer
10. Run ledger report to confirm agio posting on account 8060

date is a QUERY PARAMETER: PUT /ledger/voucher/{id}/:reverse?date=YYYY-MM-DD
